independence_declaration.statement: I (code-security-reviewer, session 400a7bd7) authored none of the DG1 implementation or the round-12 repair. The repair is 792973b (T-DG1-BE13, backend-workflow-engineer); 987ae02 is orchestrator metadata. I raised F-DG1-132 (round 10) and F-DG1-133 (round 11) and verify them here as their originating reviewer. At start the real-repo HEAD was e77be1a, not the freeze commit 987ae02. e77be1a is a direct child of 987ae02 and adds only candidate-excluded metadata: round-12 assignments, the 619d74ff manifest and stages.json. The recomputed candidate ID is 619d74ff...fdfac in the real repo and in a full disposable clone at 987ae02 (00-candidate-identity.log). Candidate identity is the content hash, and the commit is a traceability pointer (CLAUDE.md), so I proceeded, as in round 11. I checked only its file NAMES (reviews/DG1/round-12/domain-reviewer.* and runs/), and the ID is still 619d74ff (50-cleanup.log). I formed this verdict before, and without, reading any other reviewer's round-12 record. I did not open any of them.

The real tree has 0 violations. No setEngine/module-object route via named exports. The header has no 'not closable' or 'would break' citation.
checks_run.actual: Probe 30/30. All 25 must-flag plants are flagged: A1-A7, E1-E5, X1 {"default" as c}, X2 def\u0061ult, X3 import(`node:crypto`), X4 bare 'crypto', X5 export {default} from, X6 export * as default, X7 import().then, X8 import type * as (over-flag, harmless), X9 with-attributes, X10 export {"default" as c}, X11 computed import() (evasion), R1/R2 setEngine (rule 1). All 4 positive controls give 0 violations: P1 named {randomUUID, createHash}, P2 new Map(Object.entries(request.cookies)).get(name), P3 Object.entries(someObj), P4 import * as path. The real tree (11 modules, 41 files; 5 import node:crypto, all named) has []. Reachability: on Node 22.22.2 and 24.21.0 the only paths are crypto.setEngine itself and its prototype.constructor (spelled-name only, rule 1). None of the 14 third-party deps exposes the crypto module or setEngine. The header grep has no match (exit 1).

checks_run.actual: The .mts plant gives moduleViolations = [] and architecture.test.ts stays 122/122. The .ts control gives 2 violations (rule-5 namespace binding, deep import of access/policy.ts). typecheck, build and eslint all exit 0. dist contains zzx.mjs, and import() of it yields f = function setEngine. The .mjs + .d.mts variant is also unscanned, but is not copied into dist. The real tree has 0 non-.ts/.tsx files under modules. The gap is pre-existing since 8332624. Raised as F-DG1-134 (Low, non-mandatory).
